simple.meaning: שָׂנִיא (sânîyʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “hated.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Deuteronomy, beginning at Deuteronomy 21:15. Its contexts include birth, family line, firstborn.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂנִיא (H8146).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
